reason: "to spread" already covers a view spreading out before you; "open up" is the same sense reworded.
The sun dropping below the horizon is exactly "to sink / to go under" (ZH 降下); no separate referent.
"to stop or refrain from doing" is a restatement of "to cease".
"to be full" (充满) already covers 希望に満ちる; only the preposition differs.
"to break / to snap" (断, 切断) would tell a learner the battery physically broke; the run-out / expire sense of 切れる is in neither gloss line.
"to throw down" (弄倒) is the same knocking-over sense; the wind is just a different agent.
Threading a needle is the existing let-through sense (让通过) with an object; the wording nearly duplicates "to let pass".
Adverbial rewording of "smile sweetly"; no meaning added.
Verb form of the noun already glossed; 婚約した reads straight off "engagement / 订婚".
"manufacturing of goods" is "manufacture, production" with the object spelled out.
A typhoon departing is the existing "to go away / 离去"; weather is context, not a distinct sense.
Names the sentence's object (患者の命) rather than a sense; the saving sense is already "to rescue from / 拯救".
"repair of a bicycle" is the sentence's subject matter, not a sense of 修理.
"border between countries" restates "national border / 国境" in meaning.
"circle formed by people" describes what the sentence's ring is made of; ring/hoop already covers it.
"other people" is literally the existing "others / 别人".
"face, mask, surface" gives a learner nothing for 肯定的な面; the abstract aspect/facet sense is missing from the English line.
"part" (部分, 份) already covers 私の分 = my share/portion.
悩んだ末に parses off "the end of" (末尾, 最后); "after effort" is nuance of the construction, not a separate sense of 末.
"diagram or illustration" is "figure, drawing" (图表) reworded.
A clock's hand is not a needle or pin; the English line leaves 時計の針 unintelligible.
Gristle/sinew belongs to the same dictionary sense as "muscle" plus the fibrous "string" gloss; ZH 筋 is exactly the meat-tendon word.
"I beg your pardon" is already the apology sense; "I am sorry" adds nothing.
"enquiry, expression of sympathy" never conveys that the word denotes going to see the person; 見舞いに行った is opaque against the current English line.
"unit, denomination" reads as a measurement unit; the university-credit sense is missing from the English line.
"to sell in large quantities" is "to sell well / 畅销".
"female parent" is a definition of "mother", not a further sense.
"sudden violent bursting" is what "explosion, detonation" means.
"seven day period" is the definition of "week".
"down-train" (下行) is precisely the outbound-from-the-hub sense already listed.
A safety device is covered by "equipment, installation / 装置, 设备".
